behavior: resume output is a pure function of the thread file; two runs are identical
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test ./internal/mem -run '^TestResumeIsAPureRenderOfTheThreadFile$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestResumeIsAPureRenderOfTheThreadFile '

behavior: A thread with Verify and Awaiting Manu renders both, and an ambiguous working directory lists the candidates instead of choosing
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test ./internal/mem -run '^(TestResumeRendersVerifyAndAwaiting|TestResumeListsCandidatesWhenTheThreadIsAmbiguous)$' -count=1 -v) && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^--- PASS: ')" -eq 2 ]

behavior: SessionStart output begins with the resume block for source=compact and source=clear, and resume and fork get one line
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test ./internal/mem -run '^TestSessionStartResumeBySource$' -count=1 -v) && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q '^--- PASS: TestSessionStartResumeBySource '

behavior: A fixture copy of the real dotfiles MEMORY.md stays at or under 25,000 bytes after the new fields are added, and a write that would cross the budget fails instead of truncating
verification: out=$(cd cli && go test ./internal/mem -run '^(TestTheRealDotfilesMemoryStaysUnderBudgetWithTheNewFields|TestHandoffWriteRefusesAWriteThatCrossesTheByteBudget)$' -count=1 -v) && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '^--- PASS: ')" -eq 2 ]

behavior: The handoff skill points at dotf mem resume and catchup step 1 runs it
verification: grep -q 'dotf mem resume' harness/skills/handoff/SKILL.md && awk '/^### Step 1/,/^### Step 2/' harness/skills/catchup/SKILL.md | grep -q 'dotf mem resume'

behavior: The fallback sentence is in the compiled doctrine, which passes --check and stays under the 8,000-character budget
verification: grep -rq 'dotf mem resume' harness/enforced/ && ./scripts/compile-harness.sh --check && bats tests/compile-harness.bats --filter 'committed records keep the capped agy surface under 8000 characters'
